verdict.comment: A trappy race in which LONDONER is tentatively selected to defy a penalty for last week's Newcastle success. Robbo is next best.

comments.gincident: Four solid runs for new stable, including over C&D; new accessories combination; contender
comments.londoner: Penalised for last week's AW win but still has handicapping scope; strong contender
comments.robbo: Retains all his ability and appeals as the type to be winning soon; should stay this far
comments.sugarloaflenny: Not found his very best stuff so far this year; down in trip and on his last winning mark
comments.wadacregomez: Better on AW than turf but handicapped as such; easy lead possible; can't ignore

races.raceComment: wadacregomez is marginally preferred with a score of 46.9%. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 4 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Everything points towards this being the ideal opportunity for the recent C&D runner-up AM STILL HERE to make his breakthrough.

comments.amstillhere: Went under over C&D in protracted tussle on chase debut; obvious chance despite 2lb rise.
comments.chantillyrose: 12-race maiden; new headgear combination is tried; other runners are far more appealing.
comments.classicalsting: Cheekpieces replace hood; bred to be suited by switch to fences, so needs market scrutiny.
comments.deepstrato: Corbridge point winner (2m4f); essentially disappointing since switched to rules (0-8).
comments.iturgeondubreuil: 0-15 under rules; fair hurdles form here; fences - pulled up twice previously - the risk.
comments.rocknrollchamp: Maiden pointer; hasn't achieved much in six starts over hurdles; rules chasing debut.
comments.royaldeeside: Mixed messages, mostly on the Flat, since joining this trainer; 0-3 over fences.
comments.timewas: Still seeking first win under rules (0-13) but has shown glimpses of ability; a possible.

races.raceComment: amstillhere is marginally preferred with a score of 42.2%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over royaldeeside. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Yet to win at hexham in 10 attempts, though step up in class and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: In an interesting race WELL EDUCATED (nap) is taken to repeat his 2024 win, with Hardy Du Seuil and Benson his two main dangers.

comments.hardyduseuil: Quite useful; not as his best last twice; perhaps better at shorter; down in grade; chance
comments.seeastride: Ex-Gordon Elliott; winning pointer but yet to win under rules and faces a stiff task here
